description: Test suite for FastAPI application endpoints related to file uploads, including tests for uploading files via POST requests and verifying OpenAPI schema response.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Pytest fixture that dynamically imports a module corresponding to different test scenarios and creates a FastAPI TestClient instance for testing endpoints.

methods.name: test_post_form_no_body(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the POST /files/ endpoint response when no file body is sent, expecting a 200 status with a specific message.

methods.name: test_post_uploadfile_no_body(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the POST /uploadfile/ endpoint with no file sent, expecting a 200 status with a specific message.

methods.name: test_post_file(tmp_path: Path, client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests uploading a file to /files/ endpoint and verifies the response contains the file size.

methods.name: test_post_upload_file(tmp_path: Path, client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests uploading a file to /uploadfile/ endpoint and verifies the filename returned.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Checks the /openapi.json endpoint to verify the API schema matches the expected snapshot.
